Data.title: Primary Input Requirement Coefficients Of Final Demand, 2010
Data.footnote: While Table 8 (Total Requirement Coefficients In Terms Of Value Added) shows the value added generated by industries, this table shows the primary input requirements of final demand. Primary input includes imports, taxes on products, and income components of value added.
